stages.label: Cultivation
stages.title: Rooted in Varzan's soil
stages.body: Damask rose, medicinal herbs and fruit saplings grow in the highlands of Varzan village, away from urban pollution.

stages.label: Harvest
stages.title: Hand-picked, shade-dried
stages.body: Harvested by hand in season and dried in the shade — no additives, no industrial processing.

stages.label: Herbal product
stages.title: Straight from the farm to your door
stages.body: No middlemen and no long storage — packed and shipped to you directly from Varzan.

categories.title: Three product lines, one family farm
categories.subtitle: Each section of the Varzan farm is dedicated to a family of plants — at its heart, traditional medicinal and edible herbs.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add a product to your cart, enter your shipping details at checkout, and complete your order through the online payment gateway.

items.question: What does shipping cost?
items.answer: Shipping is currently free on all orders.

items.question: Can I order wholesale or place a custom order?
items.answer: Yes — get in touch through the contact page for wholesale orders or business partnerships.

items.question: How can I pay?
items.answer: Payment is made online through a secure banking gateway.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Once signed in, you can see the status and details of every order under "My orders" in your account.

about.title: About Rose Varzan
about.intro: Rose Varzan Agricultural Cooperative Company, registration No. 325, was founded in 1382 (2003) under private ownership; its main activity was resumed in 1396 (2017) by Mr. Fereydoun Alizadeh Heydari.
about.location: The company is located in Isfahan Province, Natanz County, Central District, Tarq-e Rud Rural District, Varzan village, Bagestan-e Bala Street, Sarcheshmeh Alley, postal code 8763186713, established for the cultivation of ornamental flowers, medicinal and edible plants, and stone and seedless fruit trees.
